```yaml
name: Termux Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at midnight

jobs:
  termux-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build Termux container
        run: |
          docker build -f .github/workflows/Dockerfile.termux -t btcrecover-termux .

      - name: Run tests in Termux container
        run: |
          docker run --rm btcrecover-termux python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer

  termux-test-full-requirements:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build Termux container with full requirements
        run: |
          docker build -f .github/workflows/Dockerfile.termux -t btcrecover-termux-full --build-arg REQUIREMENTS_FILE=requirements-full.txt .

      - name: Run tests with full requirements in Termux container
        run: |
          docker run --rm btcrecover-termux-full python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer

# Note: Both base and full requirements are tested in CI.
# The base requirements are tested in the first job, while the full requirements
# are tested in the second job using requirements-full.txt.
```
